title: Hanuman's Five Saffron Flags
headerSubtitle: Five complete recitals raise one saffron flag. Raise all five to prepare Hanuman's temple courtyard.
challengeCaption: Five special saffron flags are missing!

intro.title: Hanuman's Five Saffron Flags
intro.sub: Appu and Tilli arrive at Hanuman's beautiful temple.

intro.title: The special flags are missing
intro.sub: Five empty flagpoles are waiting in the courtyard.

intro.title: Listen and repeat
intro.sub: Listen carefully to Guruji and repeat each part.

intro.title: Five practices raise one flag
intro.sub: Complete five recitals today to raise the next saffron flag.

days.title: Day 1 — The first flag rises
days.sub: One special saffron flag is flying.

days.title: Day 2 — Two flags fly
days.sub: Two saffron flags now fly in the courtyard.

days.title: Day 3 — Three flags fly
days.sub: Three special flags are now raised.

days.title: Day 4 — Four flags fly
days.sub: Only one flagpole is still empty.

days.title: Day 5 — All five flags fly
days.sub: The fifth saffron flag is raised.

finale.title: The celebration begins!
finale.sub: Appu and Tilli dance with joy.

finale.title: You did it!
finale.sub: Hanuman's Five Saffron Flags challenge is complete.
